objective: The assurance ladder is an explicit typed PROGRESSION on the work object, not a single transition seam: attested through settled, each rung naming its actor, its evidence and what it does not assert, preserving the negative, inconclusive, invalid, exploit, superseded, disputed and no-fault outcomes, with no consumer treating a receipt as a verdict.
falsifiable_claim: All six ladder members are reachable in order over a WorkResult its own owner calls negative, each as its own object with its own actor_ref, evidence_refs and does_not_assert, and the six stage rows carry six distinct transitions. Six outcome classes are carried up that climb and invalid is admitted through an upheld adjudication, so every member ACC-8 clause 2 names by hand counts at least once on a real ladder and is still queryable after a daemon restart. Reaching settled does not rewrite the work: the projection still reports the owner's negative outcome_class, and five authority-bearing families that each answered 200 are byte-identical across the whole walk. A settled subject refuses a further transition; a first transition asserting verified refuses and creates no ladder; a challenge resolution outside adjudication refuses; an upheld resolution carrying a clean outcome refuses; an adjudication with no reviewer refuses; an unknown outcome class refuses -- each with the ladder's transition count and head unchanged afterwards.

code_anchors.literal: every member of the ladder is reachable in order
the authority comparison is not vacuous: every family it watches actually ANSWERED
every outcome class ACC-8 clause 2 names by hand is retained and queryable on a real ladder

adversarial_or_fault_proof: Three defects are planted in the daemon's own source, rebuilt and re-run, each required to redden the ONE assertion it names; a mutant that reddens something else is reported as a MISS, never quietly counted. The stage the caller asserts is accepted instead of checked (reddens the no-skip clause); a challenge resolution becomes claimable at any rung (reddens the one-rung clause); and a non-positive outcome is normalised on the way into the census (reddens the outcome-survival clause). All three were CAUGHT and the source restored and rebuilt clean. Every refusal assertion additionally counts BY EFFECT, re-reading the ladder afterwards and requiring the transition count and head to be unchanged, because a 4xx that still appended is the failure the shape exists to catch. The authority comparison carries its own anti-vacuity assertion: each watched family must have answered 200, which is how a non-existent route silently contributing a 404-equals-404 comparison was found in this gate's own list.
remaining_nonclaims: This gate proves the PROGRESSION. The transition seam over a non-WorkResult subject and the consumer projection's own semantics (census shape, unreached-stage independence, contract-version downgrade, bound-version history) belong to check:assurance-transition-receipt and check:verified-work-graph and are cited rather than restated -- a second set of answers to one question is a second spine waiting to disagree with the first.

Reaching settled is not a claim that any work is correct, accepted in fact, adjudicated rightly, paid for, or fit for any purpose. The gate proves the ladder records and retains; it proves nothing about the world the records describe.
Room discovery, contribution and portable-exit consumers of the ladder wait on M04.8 as this unit's scope says, and are not driven here.
One authenticated principal drives this gate. Cross-principal indistinguishability of a foreign ladder is the sibling graph gate's claim, which drives two real principals sharing one tenant.

The five authority families are read through their list routes. That they answered identically is evidence no record in them moved; it is not a proof that no authority exists anywhere else in the daemon.
